new_articles.title: GPT-6 Astra: Frontier intelligence for work, now available in Microsoft Foundry
new_articles.summary:
GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI's newest frontier model, begins rolling out today through the Microsoft Foundry Limited Access Program, with availability expanding to participating customers over the coming days.
The post GPT-6 Astra: Frontier intelligence for work, now available in Microsoft Foundry appeared first on Microsoft Azure Blog.
